description: Draw a random human birth weighted by how many people were actually born in each place and century/decade between 1 CE and 2025 (or within a chosen year), returning the birthplace, odds, life expectancy, historical events during that lifetime, and a playable BornThen link for those five lives.

seed.description: Optional deterministic alphanumeric seed so the same call reproduces the same birth.

year.description: Optional birth year (1–2025). Omit to draw across all human births since 1 CE.

name: roll_random_birth
title: Roll a random birth in human history (1 CE–2025)
